name: knight-forms-hero
_comment: Phase-3 proof: the same solid forms, ARTICULATED. rotate/skew/squash about a pivot pose the limbs (arms angled at the shoulders, a capsule sword tilted up in the right hand) while every form is shaded in its LOCAL frame with the world light pre-rotated, so a leaning limb is relit rather than its highlight spinning with it. Kept modest and heavily overlapping so it stays ONE connected piece on-canvas — verified by the checks below via `inspect`, not by eye. (Robust connection for steep poses is what a forms-skeleton, still ahead, will guarantee by construction.)
